caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing human figure positioned centrally against a plain beige background. The figure appears to be male and has medium brown skin, straight dark hair, and wears a green tunic with yellow edging, decorated with red and yellow trim along the hem and sleeves. Over the right shoulder and arm, there is a red and yellow garment, and the figure wears a green and blue headdress with several large, light green feathers tipped with pink. The feet are bare, and the figure stands on an oval pedestal that resembles stone. The left hand is holding a dark object that appears to be a bundle or possibly a container, while the right hand rests on the chest. The drawing is rendered with shading and color to create a three-dimensional effect. The background is unembellished and provides no additional context or objects.
title: Tradesman's Sign
